select briskbend(pearlforge1.ID_MEMBER,pearlforge2.ID_MEMBER) as ID_MEMBER, pearlforge1.MAILBOX as MAILBOX_1, pearlforge2. MAILBOX as MAILBOX_2 from
( SELECT ID_MEMBER,MAILBOX FROM (select CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, CEDARDELL.MAILBOX, PEARLSTONE () ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER ORDER BY DECODE(CEDARDELL.ID_KIND_MAILBOX,7,3,1,2,2,1,0)||lpad(CEDARDELL.NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW,3,0)DESC) AS FLINTTOWER from --VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLESHORE_MAPLEBARN_MEMBERS a, VDX81_OWNER.DWH_LKP_DIR_MAILBOX cedardell where --a.ID_MEMBER = cedardell.ID_MEMBER and --a.fch_maplelane is null and cedardell.fch_maplelane is null and CEDARDELL.MAILBOX is not null ) WHERE FLINTTOWER = 1) pearlforge1
FULL OUTER JOIN
( SELECT ID_MEMBER,MAILBOX FROM (select CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, CEDARDELL.MAILBOX, PEARLSTONE () ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER ORDER BY DECODE(CEDARDELL.ID_KIND_MAILBOX,7,3,1,2,2,1,0)||lpad(CEDARDELL.NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW,3,0)DESC) AS FLINTTOWER from --VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLESHORE_MAPLEBARN_MEMBERS A, VDX81_OWNER.DWH_LKP_DIR_MAILBOX CEDARDELL where --a.ID_MEMBER = cedardell.ID_MEMBER and --a.fch_maplelane is null and cedardell.fch_maplelane is null and CEDARDELL.MAILBOX is not null ) WHERE FLINTTOWER = 2) pearlforge2
ON pearlforge1.ID_MEMBER = pearlforge2.ID_MEMBER order by ID_MEMBER asc

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT ID_MEMBER, RTRIM(DESC_LOCATION) as DESC_LOCATION, BLUESPRING, DESC_LOCATION_CORALFIELD, DESC_LOCATION_CORALFIELD2, --ID_CIPHERKEY_MAILCODE, DESC_DISTRICT, DESC_CORALGATE, DESC_BIRCHYARD FROM ( select CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, cedardell.ID_KIND_LOCATION||','||cedardell.DESC_LOCATION AS DESC_LOCATION, BLUESPRING, DECODE(trim(WESTTHORP),NULL,NULL,'BOLDTRAIL:'|| trim(WESTTHORP)||' ') || DECODE(trim(WESTFORK),NULL,NULL,'WESTFORK:'|| trim(WESTFORK)||' ') || DECODE(trim(UPPERLANE),NULL,NULL,'WESTTRACK:' ||trim(UPPERLANE)||' ') || DECODE(trim(GREENDOCK),NULL,NULL, 'GREENDOCK:'|| trim(GREENDOCK))|| DECODE(trim(NAVYFIELD),NULL,NULL,'-'|| trim(NAVYFIELD)) AS DESC_LOCATION_CORALFIELD, DECODE(trim(GREENDOCK),NULL,NULL, trim(GREENDOCK)) || DECODE(trim(NAVYFIELD),NULL,NULL,'-' ||trim(NAVYFIELD)) AS DESC_LOCATION_CORALFIELD2, --ID_CIPHERKEY_MAILCODE, DESC_DISTRICT, DESC_CORALGATE, PINERIDGE.DES_BIRCHYARD AS DESC_BIRCHYARD, PEARLSTONE () ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER ORDER BY CEDARDELL.NUM_CORALPEAK ASC) AS FLINTTOWER from --VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLESHORE_MAPLEBARN_MEMBERS A, VDX81_OWNER.DWH_LKP_DIR_MAILCODE cedardell, VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLESHORE_CEDARVALE_BIRCHYARD PINERIDGE WHERE --a.ID_MEMBER = cedardell.ID_MEMBER and --a.fch_maplelane is null and cedardell.fch_maplelane is null AND cedardell.ID_KIND_LOCATION||cedardell.DESC_LOCATION IS NOT NULL AND CEDARDELL.ID_BIRCHYARD = PINERIDGE.ID_BIRCHYARD (+) AND PINERIDGE.FCH_CEDARMILL (+) IS NULL ) WHERE FLINTTOWER = 1 order by ID_MEMBER ASC

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE:
select briskbend(pearlforge1.ID_MEMBER,pearlforge2.ID_MEMBER,pearlforge3.ID_MEMBER) as ID_MEMBER, pearlforge1.NUM_PINETOWER_1, pearlforge2.NUM_PINETOWER_2, pearlforge3.NUM_PINETOWER_3
from
( select DISTINCT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_1, FLINTTOWER from ( SELECT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_1, PEARLSTONE () ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY ID_MEMBER ORDER BY ROWANWICK1 ASC) AS FLINTTOWER -- stillpass broadmarsh pearlstone redvale pinetower FROM ( SELECT CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, -- CASE WHEN ID_GRADING IN ('TEALSTEAD','2') THEN -- Briskriver pinetower uppervault y Firglade y quietstead calmford brisklake navypond no Briskriver pinetower uppervault y quietstead calmford brisklake -- KIND DIR OAKHOLLOW 1= FIRGLADE, 2 UPPERVAULT, >= 3 NORTHHEATH DECODE (ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW, 2, 0, 1) || LPAD ( NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW, 3, 0) || BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW || (2 + LENGTH (ROWANHOLLOW (LPAD (NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW, 3, 0), 0))) ROWANWICK1, BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW AS NUM_PINETOWER_1 FROM --VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLESHORE_MAPLEBARN_MEMBERS A, VDX81_OWNER.DWH_LKP_DIR_PHONELIST CEDARDELL WHERE --A.ID_MEMBER = CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER AND --A.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND CEDARDELL.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, rowanwick1 ASC)) where flinttower = 1 ) pearlforge1
FULL OUTER JOIN
( select DISTINCT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_2, FLINTTOWER from ( SELECT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_2, PEARLSTONE () ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY ID_MEMBER ORDER BY ROWANWICK2 ASC) AS FLINTTOWER -- stillpass broadmarsh pearlstone redvale pinetower FROM (SELECT CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, -- CASE WHEN ID_GRADING IN ('TEALSTEAD','2') THEN -- Briskriver calmford brisklake oakstone2 pinetower uppervault y Firglade, navypond no briskriver Briskriver calmford brisklake maplestead northpond kind 2 -- KIND DIR OAKHOLLOW 1= FIRGLADE, 2 UPPERVAULT, >= 3 NORTHHEATH DECODE (ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW, 2, 1, 0) || LPAD ( ID_LOCATION, 3, 0) || BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW || (2 + LENGTH (ROWANHOLLOW (LPAD ( ID_LOCATION, 3, 0), 0))) rowanwick2, BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW AS NUM_PINETOWER_2 FROM --VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLESHORE_MAPLEBARN_MEMBERS A, VDX81_OWNER.DWH_LKP_DIR_PHONELIST CEDARDELL WHERE --A.ID_MEMBER = CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER AND --A.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND CEDARDELL.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, rowanwick2 ASC)) where flinttower = 1 ) pearlforge2
ON pearlforge1.ID_MEMBER = pearlforge2.ID_MEMBER
FULL OUTER JOIN
( select DISTINCT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_3, FLINTTOWER from ( SELECT ID_MEMBER, NUM_PINETOWER_3, PEARLSTONE () ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY ID_MEMBER ORDER BY ROWANWICK3 ASC) AS FLINTTOWER -- stillpass broadmarsh pearlstone redvale pinetower FROM ( SELECT CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, -- CASE WHEN ID_GRADING IN ('TEALSTEAD','2') THEN -- Briskriver calmford northpond kind 11 y 9 y quietstead 4,5 y lightlane calmford brisklake, navypond no Briskriver calmford northpond kind 11 y quietstead 4,5 y lightlane calmford brisklake -- KIND DIR OAKHOLLOW 1= FIRGLADE, 2 UPPERVAULT, >= 3 NORTHHEATH DECODE (ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW, 11, 0, 4, 1, 5, 2, 3) || LPAD (NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW, 3, 0) || BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW || (2 + LENGTH (ROWANHOLLOW (LPAD (NUM_ELMCROFT_OAKHOLLOW, 3, 0), 0))) ROWANWICK3, BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW AS NUM_PINETOWER_3 --ASHFALLS2 FROM --VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLESHORE_MAPLEBARN_MEMBERS A, VDX81_OWNER.DWH_LKP_DIR_PHONELIST CEDARDELL WHERE --A.ID_MEMBER = CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER AND --A.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND CEDARDELL.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND BIRCHCLIFF || NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CEDARDELL.ID_MEMBER, rowanwick3 ASC ) ) where flinttower = 1) pearlforge3
ON pearlforge1.ID_MEMBER = pearlforge3.ID_MEMBER order by ID_MEMBER asc
